_about: The mine (scripts/mine/mine_floor.gd, Game.mine_swing). The cave mouth on the `entrance_map` leads down to `floor_map`, a cave whose rocks, soft spots and way down are laid out fresh on every entry from a seed (MineFloor.make). The hammer breaks rocks (hits per rock kind, with the hammer's charge hits from data/tools.json), the hoe digs soft spots; each one hides a find picked when the floor is made, or the hole down. A floor band is the last one whose `from` depth is at or above the floor: counts are [fewest, most], finds are weights ("none" = nothing), per source (rock, big_rock, soft). Season factors multiply a find's weight. Swings cost stamina and fatigue like field work. Only the deepest floor reached is saved. Names and numbers are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Mining.
_safe_radius: No rock or soft spot this close (in cells, either way) to where the ladder lets the farmer down.
_stairs: The hole down hides under one soft spot (that share of floors) or one rock, at least min_distance cells (x + y) from the ladder.
_seasons: Spring melt leaves the soft spots wet and full of clay; summer heat sweats amber out of old seams; fall is when agate turns up in the dry rubble; in winter frost opens the cracks where rock crystal grows.
_items: Mine finds are rucksack items "mine:<id>": name, kind (stone / ore / gem), sell (G in the bin), look (icon shape and colours for PlaceholderArt). Ores are for the smithy's tool upgrades later.
